title: Course catalog index
description: Top-level metadata for every course on the platform. Each entry points at a per-course dataset directory containing topics.json and dependencies.json.

id.description: Unique course id; also the name of the dataset directory under data/.

code.description: Course code as printed in the syllabus, e.g. 'BIO 301'.

subject.description: Subject area used for catalog filtering, e.g. 'Biology'.

topic_count.description: Must equal the number of entries in the course's topics.json.
